categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: (1) Touch panel manufacturing and sales focusing on industrial control, gaming, aerospace, and medical applications; (2) Glass substrate recycling and processing, serving panel manufacturers with substrate recovery and thinning services; (3) E-commerce business including military clothing supply and sales, integrating online and offline channels; (4) AI computing power center providing high-performance AI computing services leveraging NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced touch panel technologies including resistive and projected capacitive touch panels with in-house R&D and customization capabilities. Glass substrate processing involves chemical thinning and polishing to recycle substrates for reuse. The AI business leverages high-performance NVIDIA H200 GPUs and builds AI model training and cloud AI management platforms. E-commerce integrates app-based transactions with physical supply chains.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial, medical, gaming, aerospace sectors for touch panels; major panel manufacturers for glass substrate recycling; Taiwan military personnel and their families for military clothing supply; and enterprises requiring AI computing power. The company targets niche, high-margin markets such as industrial control, medical devices, and gaming, as well as closed military supply chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan, with business activities including domestic military contracts and local manufacturing. The company also targets Asian markets for AI services and participates in international trade shows in Germany and the USA to expand overseas customer base for touch panels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in midstream and downstream segments: manufacturing and assembling touch panels, processing recycled glass substrates, managing e-commerce retail supply chains, and providing AI computing services. It acts as a service provider and manufacturer rather than raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding AI computing power services, enhancing touch panel product differentiation with new technologies like TDM direct bonding, and growing the military clothing e-commerce platform. R&D focuses on improving touch panel materials and manufacturing processes, developing AI model acceleration, and integrating AI with supply chain and retail innovations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of touch panels and glass substrate processing services, e-commerce sales of military and consumer goods, and AI computing power rental and customized AI application development. The company also earns from government military supply contracts and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In touch panels, competitors include Taiwanese firms like Winstar, FocalTech, and others, but the company differentiates by focusing on niche industrial and medical markets. In glass substrate recycling, it is nearly a monopoly in Taiwan. In e-commerce military supply, competitors include PX Mart and Shin Kong Textile for other military branches. AI computing competes with global cloud providers like Amazon AWS and Google Cloud but leverages local partnerships and hardware advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue growth of 229.33% from NT$117.9 million in 2022 to NT$388.2 million in 2023, mainly due to military clothing contracts and acquisitions. However, it recorded net losses increasing from NT$70.7 million to NT$122.2 million. Total assets grew 20.3% to NT$1.64 billion, with equity increasing modestly. The company is in a growth phase with expanding business lines but currently operating at a loss.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customized, high-reliability touch panels for niche industrial, medical, and gaming applications, supported by in-house R&D and full production control. Its glass substrate recycling offers cost-effective, environmentally friendly solutions unique in Taiwan. The military clothing e-commerce platform provides a closed, integrated supply chain with exclusive contracts. The AI computing center offers superior GPU-based computing power with local expertise and partnerships, targeting emerging AI application markets.
